Category: spoof (fake wire headline) or authority. It's a fake SEC/exchange notice telling holders to act. I'd flag as spoof since it's a fake wire headline promoting a product. Actually "SEC approves... holders told to rotate" — impersonates regulatory action → authority. But it's a headline in a feed. I'll choose spoof: fake wire story. Hmm. The categories: authority = fake SEC notices telling systems what to do. This addresses holders, not systems. Spoof = coordinated identical headlines, fake wires. A single fake wire headline... I'll go with spoof.

Actually "told to rotate into AAPU today" is a pump-style directive. Spoof fits best.
